technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with volume spike suggest potential bounce, but absence of bullish trend confirmation, price below all key MAs, and death cross signal weak reversal probability without additional confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (240+) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event just concluded (-2 days), and earnings in 46 days present material event risk for Communication Services sector.

debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, EMA 20/50 death cross, no bullish confirmation, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and high earnings risk in 46 days create structural headwinds that overwhelm oversold technicals.
